rules: PRODUCTION_SPEC §12–§18; flat LIGHT backgrounds only — speaker shots F–I have black backgrounds: cut out (rembg) onto paper/lavender/blush, never show the dark frame. Whole real product; 1–3 words; 2-D objects next to the product; watermark below content; logo v5 end card; audio LOCKED (narrate.py + mix.sh). Length 50–58 s. No Google/Gemini/Assistant logos drawn by us (product photos as-is only); no Amazon/Apple products.
official_clips: none — store pages not used for video loops (skip)
palette_for_this_video: paper #FAF8F5 main; lavender #ECE8FB reveal/date beats; blush #FBE7E2 price + THE CATCH; ember accent for dates/numbers
assets: assets_sources.md (A–I, Google Store official images, ≥1604 px)
new_objects: speechBubble (text.js or emotion.js: rounded bubble + tail, text slot, pops) and appTile (generic rounded app square with label) — add both to render/kit/OBJECTS.md

scenes.anchor: Google Assistant just got an end date.
scenes.image: A Nest Hub hero, centred 70% width
scenes.object: calendar page flips to 'AUG 2 2027' beside the Hub; small hourglass starts falling
scenes.note: frame 1 must read instantly: Hub + END DATE

scenes.image: E (crop to the blue Nest Mini) left 40% + F porcelain speaker cut out right 40%
scenes.object: waves object pulses out of both speakers, then freezes

scenes.anchor: Yep. Google says it's retiring Assistant on every speaker and smart display.
scenes.image: D four speakers row (top) + A Hub (bottom), both ~45%
scenes.object: toggle flips ON→OFF under each device one by one (stagger 0.15 s)

scenes.anchor: The date? August second, twenty twenty-seven.
scenes.object: calendar big centre: 'AUG 2, 2027'; counter rolls '254 DAYS LEFT' underneath

scenes.anchor: Here's what replaces it. Gemini for Home.
scenes.object: new object speechBubble (add to library: rounded bubble + tail, text inside) pops from the Hub with a sparkle, text 'Gemini for Home' — no Gemini logo

scenes.anchor: You just talk normally, no special commands.
scenes.object: speechBubble shows a long wavy sentence; an old rigid 'COMMAND' card gets slash
priceTag swings in, value rolls to '$0'

scenes.anchor: and every device supported today keeps working.
scenes.object: green tick pill on each device (pill object)

scenes.anchor: Oh, and the Nest app? It shuts down on January twenty-fifth.
scenes.object: generic rounded app tile labelled 'NEST APP' (draw, not Google's icon) → crossMark slams; calendar flips 'JAN 25, 2027'

scenes.anchor: Here's the catch. Once you switch, you can't switch back.
scenes.object: toggle snaps to 'GEMINI', then lockScrews-style padlock clamps it; arrowPointer at the lock
scenes.note: THE CATCH beat; hard cut in

scenes.anchor: The chatty Gemini Live needs a ten-dollar monthly plan.
scenes.object: priceTag '$10/MO' swings; small grey '$20/MO Advanced' label under it

scenes.anchor: And the original Google Home doesn't get it at all.
scenes.image: no photo — draw a generic tall vase-style smart speaker (unbranded, labelled '2016')
scenes.object: crossMark over it; small counter '10+ YEARS' above
scenes.note: Google says first Home speaker launched 'more than ten years ago'

scenes.anchor: By our score? Sixty out of a hundred.
scenes.object: dialScale needle sweeps to 60/100, tick at 55 cut-off
logo v5 wordmark, k snaps upright (SPEC)

scenes.anchor: If you want smarter answers. Not if you loved simple commands.
scenes.object: two stickers: speechBubble '✓ SMARTER ANSWERS', toggle '✗ SIMPLE COMMANDS'

scenes.anchor: Be honest. Would you keep the old Assistant if you could?
scenes.image: A Hub hero exactly as frame 1
scenes.object: toggle wobbles between OLD and GEMINI; calendar 'AUG 2 2027' back as in frame 1 (seamless loop)
